subtle.$description: Sidebars, AI message bubbles, quiet panels.

hover.$description: Hover fill for Secondary/Ghost buttons and menu rows.

pressed.$description: Pressed state of Secondary and Ghost buttons and tappable rows.

disabled.$description: Disabled control fill; pair with text-disabled.

strong.$description: Toggle track when off, neutral swipe actions, sheet handles. Holds 3:1 against bg-default and bg-subtle (it marks a control).

inverse.$description: Tooltips and inverse surfaces; text-inverse on it.

overlay.$description: Scrim behind modals, drawers and sheets.

brand.$description: Primary buttons, selected states, user chat bubbles. text-on-brand on it.

selected.$description: Fill of selected controls: checked checkbox and radio, toggle on, slider and progress fill. Holds 3:1 against bg-default in both themes; icons on it use icon-on-brand.

brand-subtle.$description: Brand badge, selected menu row, avatar initials.

success-subtle.$description: Success badge background; text-success on it.

warning-subtle.$description: Warning badge background; text-warning on it.

danger-subtle.$description: Danger badge background; text-danger on it.

primary.$description: Body and heading text on bg-default, bg-subtle, bg-muted.

secondary.$description: Descriptions, captions, helper text on bg-default and bg-subtle.

placeholder.$description: Input placeholders on bg-default and bg-subtle. Not on bg-muted (4.3:1).

disabled.$description: Disabled labels on bg-disabled. Not for readable content.

on-brand.$description: Text and icons on bg-brand and bg-danger.

brand.$description: Links, selected tab/menu text, brand badge text.

danger.$description: Error messages and danger badge text.

default.$description: Decorative separation only: card outlines, dividers, table rules. Below 3:1 by design; never the only cue that something is a control.

strong.$description: Borders that identify a control: inputs, selects, checkboxes, radios, Secondary buttons. Holds 3:1 against bg-default and bg-subtle in both themes (WCAG 1.4.11).

focus.$description: Focused input border; pair with the focus-ring shadow.

secondary.$description: Icons inside inputs, close buttons, chevrons.

2xs.$description: Toggle knob inset, badge vertical padding.

xs.$description: Label-to-field gap, icon-to-text in tight rows.

sm.$description: Gap between buttons, menu padding, small button icon gap.

md.$description: Small button & input horizontal padding, chat avatar gap.

lg.$description: Medium button padding, card gap, sidebar padding.

xl.$description: Card & modal padding, gap between chat messages.

md.$description: The default: buttons, inputs, selects, badges, cards.

xl.$description: Bottom sheets and action sheets (top corners).

touch.$description: Minimum tap target on touch screens (buttons, list rows, icons in bars).

row.$description: Mobile list row height with one line of text.

row-2.$description: Mobile list row height with title and subtitle.

bottom-nav.$description: Mobile bottom navigation height, before the safe-area inset.

heading-h3.$description: Subsections, modal titles on large dialogs.

heading-h4.$description: Card titles, modal titles, app header.

body-small.$description: UI text, chat messages, inputs, descriptions.

label-xsmall.$description: Bottom nav labels, citation numbers, keyboard keys, count badges. The smallest text in the system.

focus-ring.$description: Keyboard focus on every interactive control: a 2px gap in the page color, then a solid 2px indigo ring (4.5:1 on white, 6:1 on dark).

focus-ring-inset.$description: Keyboard focus for full-bleed rows and tabs where an outer ring would be clipped (list items, bottom nav, conversation rows).
